description: In a well-order of uncountable cofinality, intersecting fewer than the cofinality many club-filter members gives another member.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.clubFilter_complete.{u, v} {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α]
  (hα : Cardinal.aleph0 < Order.cof α) {ι : Type v}
  (hι : Cardinal.lift.{u, v} (Cardinal.mk ι) < Cardinal.lift.{v, u} (Order.cof α)) (A : ι → Set α)
  (hA : ∀ (i : ι), A i ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.clubFilter α) : ⋂ i, A i ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.clubFilter α
